brand_notes: Signature trim of the 705 S3 with Mundorf caps, carbon-dome tweeter, rear Flowport; price $5,200 vs $3,150-3,800 for standard 705 S3. HFN lab shows ~8 dB treble uptilt and sens well below claimed 88 dB; B&W rated min impedance 3.7 ohm vs measured 4.7. B&W consistently quotes 88 dB sensitivity that measurements do not support (hifinews-*, soundstage-*).
takeaways: Only Tier-B measurement is HFN lab: sens 86.0 dB mean / 84.1 dB @1 kHz vs claimed 88
Min impedance 4.7 ohm @175 Hz (claimed 3.7), EPDR 2.2 ohm @120 Hz -> below-iec flag
f6 53 Hz; ~8 dB lift 1-10 kHz, axial error ±4.1 dB
Critics: detailed, energetic, forward treble; big premium over standard 705 S3
No Klippel/NRC data and no user reports found
